newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SAS adding two flights/week to Zagreb starting Oct.
newsitem.headline: SAS adding two flights/week to Zagreb starting Oct.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) plans to increase the number of flights between Copenhagen and Zagreb to six a week from four starting October 28, Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Monday.
Lufthansa is the general sales agent for SAS in Croatia.

The new connections will arrive in Zagreb on Mondays and Wedenesdays, supplementing services on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, said Vlado Bukovac, Lufthansa station manager at Zagreb Airport.
SAS routes to Zagreb are flown normally on 115-seat DC-9-94s and occasionally on 95-seat DC-9-92s, Bukovac said.
